          description: Updated wishlist
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/WishlistResponse'
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
  /wishlist/import:
    post:
      tags: [Wishlist]
      operationId: importWishlist
      summary: Import local guest wishlist product IDs
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ImportWishlistRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Merged wishlist
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/WishlistResponse'
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
  /checkout/quote:
    post:
      tags: [Checkout]
      operationId: createCheckoutQuote
      summary: Compute shipping, tax, coupon, and totals
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CheckoutQuoteRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Quote
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/CheckoutQuoteResponse'
        '400':
          description: Invalid address or coupon
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized when using server cart
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
  /orders:
    post:
      tags: [Orders]
      operationId: createOrder
      summary: Place order (pending_payment, reserves stock)
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateOrderRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Order created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderDetail'
        '400':
          description: Stock or validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
    get:
      tags: [Orders]
      operationId: listOrders
      summary: List my orders
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/Page'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/PageSize'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Paginated orders
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderListResponse'
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
  /orders/{orderId}:
    get:
      tags: [Orders]
      operationId: getOrderById
      summary: Get order detail
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/OrderId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Order detail
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderDetail'
        '404':
          description: Not found
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
  /orders/{orderId}/complete-mock-payment:
    post:
      tags: [Orders]
      operationId: completeMockPayment
      summary: Demo pay-now (marks order paid, no Stripe)
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/OrderId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Payment succeeded
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderDetail'
        '409':
          description: Order not payable
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
  /orders/{orderId}/cancel:
    post:
      tags: [Orders]
      operationId: cancelOrder
      summary: Cancel pending_payment order and release stock
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/OrderId'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Cancelled order
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderDetail'
        '409':
          description: Not cancellable
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          description: Unauthorized
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
  /support/messages:
    post:
      tags: [Support]
      operationId: submitSupportMessage
      summary: Submit support form (simulated send)
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/SupportMessageRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Message recorded
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/SupportMessageResponse'
        '400':
          description: Validation error
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  parameters:
    Page:
      name: page
      in: query
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        default: 1
    PageSize:
      name: pageSize
      in: query
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        maximum: 100
        default: 24
    ProductId:
      name: productId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    OrderId:
      name: orderId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
  schemas:
    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [statusCode, error, message]
      properties:
        statusCode:
          type: integer
        error:
          type: string
        message:
          oneOf:
            - type: string
            - type: array
              items:
                type: string
    HealthResponse:
      type: object
      required: [status, database, timestamp]
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [ok, degraded]
        database:
          type: string
          enum: [up, down]
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    Money:
      type: object
      required: [amountCents, currency]
      properties:
        amountCents:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        currency:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[A-Z]{3}$'
          example: USD
    MessageResponse:
      type: object
      required: [message]
      properties:
        message:
          type: string
    RegisterRequest:
      type: object
      required: [email, password]
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        password:
          type: string
          minLength: 8
          description: At least one letter and one number
    LoginRequest:
      type: object
      required: [email, password]
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        password:
          type: string
    LogoutRequest:
      type: object
      required: [refreshToken]
      properties:
        refreshToken:
          type: string
    RefreshRequest:
      type: object
      required: [refreshToken]
      properties:
        refreshToken:
          type: string
    AuthResponse:
      type: object
      required: [accessToken, refreshToken, expiresInSeconds, user]
      properties:
        accessToken:
          type: string
        refreshToken:
          type: string
        expiresInSeconds:
          type: integer
          example: 900
        user:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/UserSummary'
    UserSummary:
      type: object
      required: [id, email]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
    ForgotPasswordRequest:
      type: object
      required: [email]
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
    ForgotPasswordResponse:
      type: object
      required: [message]
      properties:
        message:
          type: string
        demoResetToken:
          type: string
          description: Present in demo builds when account exists; production would email a link instead
    ResetPasswordRequest:
      type: object
      required: [email, resetToken, newPassword]
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        resetToken:
          type: string
        newPassword:
          type: string
          minLength: 8
    Category:
      type: object
      required: [id, name, slug]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
        slug:
          type: string
    CategoryListResponse:
      type: object
      required: [items]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
    AvailabilityFilter:
      type: string
      enum: [in_stock, low_stock, out_of_stock]
    AvailabilityStatus:
      type: string
      enum: [in_stock, low_stock, out_of_stock]
    ProductSummary:
      type: object
      required: [id, name, brand, category, price, primaryImageUrl, availability]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
        brand:
          type: string
        category:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        price:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        primaryImageUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
        availability:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/AvailabilityStatus'
    ProductListResponse:
      type: object
      required: [items, total, page, pageSize]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductSummary'
        total:
          type: integer
        page:
          type: integer
        pageSize:
          type: integer
    ProductVariant:
      type: object
      required: [id, sku, name, price, stockAvailable, isDefault]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        sku:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        price:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        stockAvailable:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        imageUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
        isDefault:
          type: boolean
    ProductDetail:
      type: object
      required: [id, name, brand, description, category, price, primaryImageUrl, availability, variants]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
        brand:
          type: string
        description:
          type: string
        category:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        price:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        primaryImageUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
        availability:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/AvailabilityStatus'
        variants:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductVariant'
    HomeBanner:
      type: object
      required: [id, title, imageUrl]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        title:
          type: string
        subtitle:
          type: string
        imageUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
        ctaLabel:
          type: string
        categorySlug:
          type: string
    HomeResponse:
      type: object
      required: [banners, featured, newArrivals, categories]
      properties:
        banners:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/HomeBanner'
        featured:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductSummary'
        newArrivals:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductSummary'
        categories:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
    CartLineInput:
      type: object
      required: [variantId, quantity]
      properties:
        variantId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        quantity:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
    CartItem:
      type: object
      required: [id, variantId, productId, productName, variantName, quantity, unitPrice, lineTotal]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        variantId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        productId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        productName:
          type: string
        variantName:
          type: string
        quantity:
          type: integer
        unitPrice:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        lineTotal:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
    CartResponse:
      type: object
      required: [items, subtotal]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CartItem'
        subtotal:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
    ReplaceCartRequest:
      type: object
      required: [items]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CartLineInput'
    MergeCartRequest:
      type: object
      required: [guestItems]
      properties:
        guestItems:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CartLineInput'
        strategy:
          type: string
          enum: [merge, guest_wins]
          default: merge
    WishlistItem:
      type: object
      required: [productId, addedAt]
      properties:
        productId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        addedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    WishlistResponse:
      type: object
      required: [items]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/WishlistItem'
    ReplaceWishlistRequest:
      type: object
      required: [productIds]
      properties:
        productIds:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
            format: uuid
    ImportWishlistRequest:
      type: object
      required: [productIds]
      properties:
        productIds:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
            format: uuid
    ShippingAddress:
      type: object
      required: [fullName, line1, city, region, postalCode, country]
      properties:
        fullName:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        phone:
          type: string
        line1:
          type: string
        line2:
          type: string
        city:
          type: string
        region:
          type: string
          description: US state code
        postalCode:
          type: string
        country:
          type: string
          enum: [US]
    CouponValidation:
      type: object
      required: [valid]
      properties:
        valid:
          type: boolean
        code:
          type: string
        rejectionReason:
          type: string
          enum: [invalid, expired, minimum_not_met, excluded_items, already_applied]
        discount:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
    CheckoutQuoteRequest:
      type: object
      required: [shippingAddress]
      properties:
        useServerCart:
          type: boolean
          default: true
        lines:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CartLineInput'
        shippingAddress:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShippingAddress'
        couponCode:
          type: string
    CheckoutQuoteResponse:
      type: object
      required: [lines, subtotal, discount, shipping, tax, total, coupon]
      properties:
        lines:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CartItem'
        subtotal:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        discount:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        shipping:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        tax:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        total:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        coupon:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/CouponValidation'
        taxDisclaimer:
          type: string
    CreateOrderRequest:
      type: object
      required: [shippingAddress, idempotencyKey]
      properties:
        shippingAddress:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShippingAddress'
        couponCode:

        useServerCart:
          type: boolean
          default: true
        lines:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CartLineInput'
        idempotencyKey:
          type: string
          maxLength: 64
    ShopperOrderStatus:
      type: string
      enum: [awaiting_payment, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded]
    OrderSummary:
      type: object
      required: [id, orderNumber, createdAt, total, shopperStatus]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        orderNumber:
          type: string
          example: SE-20261004-A1B2C3
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        total:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        shopperStatus:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShopperOrderStatus'
    OrderListResponse:
      type: object
      required: [items, total, page, pageSize]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderSummary'
        total:
          type: integer
        page:
          type: integer
        pageSize:
          type: integer
    OrderLineItem:
      type: object
      required: [productName, variantName, sku, quantity, unitPrice, lineTotal]
      properties:
        productName:
          type: string
        variantName:
          type: string
        sku:
          type: string
        quantity:
          type: integer
        unitPrice:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        lineTotal:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
    OrderDetail:
      type: object
      required: [id, orderNumber, createdAt, shopperStatus, backendStatus, lines, subtotal, discount, shipping, tax, total, shippingAddress]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        orderNumber:
          type: string
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time

        discount:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        shipping:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        tax:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        total:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        couponCode:
          type: string
        shippingAddress:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShippingAddress'
        carrierName:
          type: string
        trackingNumber:
          type: string
    SupportMessageRequest:
      type: object
      required: [email, subject, body]

        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        subject:
          type: string
          maxLength: 120
        body:
          type: string
          maxLength: 2000
        orderNumber:
          type: string
    SupportMessageResponse:
      type: object
      required: [id, message]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        message:
          type: string
security:

","prisma_schema":"generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum OrderStatus {
  pending_payment
  paid
  fulfilled
  delivered
  cancelled
  refunded
}

enum PaymentProvider {
  MOCK
  STRIPE
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  requires_payment_method
  processing
  succeeded
  canceled
  failed
}

enum CouponType {
  PERCENT
  FIXED_AMOUNT
}

enum CouponExclusionKind {
  CATEGORY
  PRODUCT
}

enum AddressLabel {
  home
  work
  other
}

model User {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  email        String    @unique @db.VarChar(255)
  passwordHash String    @map("password_hash") @db.VarChar(255)
  displayName  String?   @map("display_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  deletedAt    DateTime? @map("deleted_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  refreshTokens       RefreshToken[]
  passwordResetTokens PasswordResetToken[]
  addresses           Address[]
  cart                Cart?
  wishlist            Wishlist?
  orders              Order[]
  supportMessages     SupportMessage[]

  @@map("users")
}

model RefreshToken {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId    String    @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  tokenHash String    @map("token_hash") @db.VarChar(255)
  expiresAt DateTime  @map("expires_at") @db.Timestamptz
  revokedAt DateTime? @map("revoked_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("refresh_tokens")
}

model PasswordResetToken {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId    String    @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  tokenHash String    @map("token_hash") @db.VarChar(255)
  expiresAt DateTime  @map("expires_at") @db.Timestamptz
  usedAt    DateTime? @map("used_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("password_reset_tokens")
}

model Address {
  id         String       @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId     String       @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  label      AddressLabel @default(home)
  fullName   String       @map("full_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  line1      String       @db.VarChar(200)
  line2      String?      @db.VarChar(200)
  city       String       @db.VarChar(100)
  region     String       @db.VarChar(100)
  postalCode String       @map("postal_code") @db.VarChar(20)
  country    String       @default("US") @db.VarChar(2)
  isDefault  Boolean      @default(false) @map("is_default")
  createdAt  DateTime     @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt  DateTime     @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("addresses")
}

model StoreConfig {
  id                      Int      @id @default(1)
  currency                String   @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  freeShippingThresholdCents Int   @default(7500) @map("free_shipping_threshold_cents")
  flatShippingCents       Int      @default(599) @map("flat_shipping_cents")
  taxRateBps              Int      @default(800) @map("tax_rate_bps")
  lowStockThreshold       Int      @default(5) @map("low_stock_threshold")
  supportEmail            String   @default("support@shopease-demo.com") @map("support_email") @db.VarChar(255)
  createdAt               DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt               DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  @@map("store_config")
}

model Category {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  name      String   @db.VarChar(100)
  slug      String   @unique @db.VarChar(100)
  sortOrder Int      @default(0) @map("sort_order")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  products Product[]

  @@map("categories")
}

model HomeBanner {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  title        String   @db.VarChar(120)
  subtitle     String?  @db.VarChar(200)
  imageUrl     String   @map("image_url") @db.VarChar(500)
  ctaLabel     String?  @map("cta_label") @db.VarChar(60)
  categorySlug String?  @map("category_slug") @db.VarChar(100)
  sortOrder    Int      @default(0) @map("sort_order")
  isActive     Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  @@map("home_banners")
}

model Product {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  categoryId      String   @map("category_id") @db.Uuid
  name            String   @db.VarChar(200)
  slug            String   @unique @db.VarChar(200)
  brand           String   @db.VarChar(100)
  description     String   @db.Text
  primaryImageUrl String   @map("primary_image_url") @db.VarChar(500)
  isActive        Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  isFeatured      Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_featured")
  isNewArrival    Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_new_arrival")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  category Category         @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id])
  variants ProductVariant[]
  wishlistItems WishlistItem[]
  couponExclusions CouponExclusion[]

  @@index([categoryId])
  @@index([brand])
  @@index([isActive, isFeatured])
  @@index([isActive, isNewArrival])
  @@map("products")
}

model ProductVariant {
  id               String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  productId        String   @map("product_id") @db.Uuid
  sku              String   @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  name             String   @db.VarChar(120)
  priceCents       Int      @map("price_cents")
  currency         String   @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  stockQuantity    Int      @default(0) @map("stock_quantity")
  reservedQuantity Int      @default(0) @map("reserved_quantity")
  imageUrl         String?  @map("image_url") @db.VarChar(500)
  isDefault        Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_default")
  isActive         Boolean  @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt        DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt        DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  product   Product     @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  cartItems CartItem[]
  orderItems OrderItem[]

  @@index([productId])
  @@map("product_variants")
}

model Cart {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId    String   @unique @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user  User       @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items CartItem[]

  @@map("carts")
}

model CartItem {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  cartId         String   @map("cart_id") @db.Uuid
  variantId      String   @map("variant_id") @db.Uuid
  quantity       Int      @default(1)
  unitPriceCents Int      @map("unit_price_cents")
  currency       String   @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  productName    String   @map("product_name") @db.VarChar(200)
  variantName    String   @map("variant_name") @db.VarChar(120)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  cart    Cart           @relation(fields: [cartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variant ProductVariant @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id])

  @@unique([cartId, variantId])
  @@index([cartId])
  @@map("cart_items")
}

model Wishlist {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId    String   @unique @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user  User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items WishlistItem[]

  @@map("wishlists")
}

model WishlistItem {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  wishlistId String  @map("wishlist_id") @db.Uuid
  productId String   @map("product_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  wishlist Wishlist @relation(fields: [wishlistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product  Product  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([wishlistId, productId])
  @@map("wishlist_items")
}

model Coupon {
  id                 String     @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  code               String     @unique @db.VarChar(32)
  type               CouponType
  percentOff         Int?       @map("percent_off")
  amountOffCents     Int?       @map("amount_off_cents")
  currency           String     @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  minSubtotalCents   Int        @default(0) @map("min_subtotal_cents")
  startsAt           DateTime?  @map("starts_at") @db.Timestamptz
  expiresAt          DateTime?  @map("expires_at") @db.Timestamptz
  maxRedemptions     Int?       @map("max_redemptions")
  redemptionCount    Int        @default(0) @map("redemption_count")
  isActive           Boolean    @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt          DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt          DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  exclusions CouponExclusion[]
  orders     Order[]

  @@map("coupons")
}

model CouponExclusion {
  id         String              @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  couponId   String              @map("coupon_id") @db.Uuid
  kind       CouponExclusionKind
  categoryId String?             @map("category_id") @db.Uuid
  productId  String?             @map("product_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt  DateTime            @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt  DateTime            @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  coupon  Coupon   @relation(fields: [couponId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product? @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([couponId])
  @@map("coupon_exclusions")
}

model Order {
  id                      String      @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId                  String      @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  orderNumber             String      @unique @map("order_number") @db.VarChar(32)
  status                  OrderStatus @default(pending_payment)
  currency                String      @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  subtotalCents           Int         @map("subtotal_cents")
  discountCents           Int         @default(0) @map("discount_cents")
  shippingCents           Int         @default(0) @map("shipping_cents")
  taxCents                Int         @default(0) @map("tax_cents")
  totalCents              Int         @map("total_cents")
  couponId                String?     @map("coupon_id") @db.Uuid
  couponCode              String?     @map("coupon_code") @db.VarChar(32)
  shippingAddressSnapshot Json        @map("shipping_address_snapshot")
  carrierName             String?     @map("carrier_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  trackingNumber          String?     @map("tracking_number") @db.VarChar(100)
  idempotencyKey          String?     @unique @map("idempotency_key") @db.VarChar(64)
  paidAt                  DateTime?   @map("paid_at") @db.Timestamptz
  fulfilledAt             DateTime?   @map("fulfilled_at") @db.Timestamptz
  deliveredAt             DateTime?   @map("delivered_at") @db.Timestamptz
  cancelledAt             DateTime?   @map("cancelled_at") @db.Timestamptz
  paymentExpiresAt        DateTime?   @map("payment_expires_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt               DateTime    @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt               DateTime    @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user    User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  coupon  Coupon?  @relation(fields: [couponId], references: [id])
  items   OrderItem[]
  payment Payment?

  @@index([userId, createdAt(sort: Desc)])
  @@index([status])
  @@map("orders")
}

model OrderItem {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId        String   @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  variantId      String?  @map("variant_id") @db.Uuid
  productName    String   @map("product_name") @db.VarChar(200)
  variantName    String   @map("variant_name") @db.VarChar(120)
  sku            String   @db.VarChar(64)
  quantity       Int
  unitPriceCents Int      @map("unit_price_cents")
  currency       String   @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  lineTotalCents Int      @map("line_total_cents")
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  order   Order           @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variant ProductVariant? @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([orderId])
  @@map("order_items")
}

model Payment {
  id                    String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  orderId               String          @unique @map("order_id") @db.Uuid
  provider              PaymentProvider @default(MOCK)
  status                PaymentStatus
  amountCents           Int             @map("amount_cents")
  currency              String          @default("USD") @db.VarChar(3)
  stripePaymentIntentId String?         @unique @map("stripe_payment_intent_id") @db.VarChar(255)
  mockReference         String?         @map("mock_reference") @db.VarChar(64)
  createdAt             DateTime        @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt             DateTime        @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  order Order @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("payments")
}

model SupportMessage {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId      String?  @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  email       String   @db.VarChar(255)
  subject     String   @db.VarChar(120)
  body        String   @db.Text
  orderNumber String?  @map("order_number") @db.VarChar(32)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user User? @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@map("support_messages")
}
"}

    cart, wishlist, checkout quotes, orders, mock payment, coupons, and support.

components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  parameters:
    Page:
      name: page
      in: query
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        default: 1
    PageSize:
      name: pageSize
      in: query
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        maximum: 100
        default: 24
    ProductId:
      name: productId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    OrderId:
      name: orderId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
  schemas:
    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [statusCode, error, message]
      properties:
        statusCode:
          type: integer
        error:
          type: string
        message:
          oneOf:
            - type: string
            - type: array
              items:
                type: string
    HealthResponse:
      type: object
      required: [status, database, timestamp]
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [ok, degraded]
        database:
          type: string
          enum: [up, down]
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    Money:
      type: object
      required: [amountCents, currency]
      properties:
        amountCents:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        currency:
          type: string
          pattern: '^[A-Z]{3}$'
          example: USD
    MessageResponse:
      type: object
      required: [message]
      properties:
        message:
          type: string
    RegisterRequest:
      type: object
      required: [email, password]
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        password:
          type: string
          minLength: 8
          description: At least one letter and one number
    LoginRequest:
      type: object
      required: [email, password]
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        password:
          type: string
    LogoutRequest:
      type: object
      required: [refreshToken]
      properties:
        refreshToken:
          type: string
    RefreshRequest:
      type: object
      required: [refreshToken]
      properties:
        refreshToken:
          type: string
    AuthResponse:
      type: object
      required: [accessToken, refreshToken, expiresInSeconds, user]
      properties:
        accessToken:
          type: string
        refreshToken:
          type: string
        expiresInSeconds:
          type: integer
          example: 900
        user:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/UserSummary'
    UserSummary:
      type: object
      required: [id, email]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
    ForgotPasswordRequest:
      type: object
      required: [email]
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
    ForgotPasswordResponse:
      type: object
      required: [message]
      properties:
        message:
          type: string
        demoResetToken:
          type: string
          description: Present in demo builds when account exists; production would email a link instead
    ResetPasswordRequest:
      type: object
      required: [email, resetToken, newPassword]
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        resetToken:
          type: string
        newPassword:
          type: string
          minLength: 8
    Category:
      type: object
      required: [id, name, slug]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
        slug:
          type: string
    CategoryListResponse:
      type: object
      required: [items]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
    AvailabilityFilter:
      type: string
      enum: [in_stock, low_stock, out_of_stock]
    AvailabilityStatus:
      type: string
      enum: [in_stock, low_stock, out_of_stock]
    ProductSummary:
      type: object
      required: [id, name, brand, category, price, primaryImageUrl, availability]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
        brand:
          type: string
        category:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        price:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        primaryImageUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
        availability:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/AvailabilityStatus'
    ProductListResponse:
      type: object
      required: [items, total, page, pageSize]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductSummary'
        total:
          type: integer
        page:
          type: integer
        pageSize:
          type: integer
    ProductVariant:
      type: object
      required: [id, sku, name, price, stockAvailable, isDefault]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        sku:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        price:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        stockAvailable:
          type: integer
          minimum: 0
        imageUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
        isDefault:
          type: boolean
    ProductDetail:
      type: object
      required: [id, name, brand, description, category, price, primaryImageUrl, availability, variants]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
        brand:
          type: string
        description:
          type: string
        category:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        price:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        primaryImageUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
        availability:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/AvailabilityStatus'
        variants:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductVariant'
    HomeBanner:
      type: object
      required: [id, title, imageUrl]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        title:
          type: string
        subtitle:
          type: string
        imageUrl:
          type: string
          format: uri
        ctaLabel:
          type: string
        categorySlug:
          type: string
    HomeResponse:
      type: object
      required: [banners, featured, newArrivals, categories]
      properties:
        banners:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/HomeBanner'
        featured:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductSummary'
        newArrivals:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProductSummary'
        categories:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
    CartLineInput:
      type: object
      required: [variantId, quantity]
      properties:
        variantId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        quantity:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
    CartItem:
      type: object
      required: [id, variantId, productId, productName, variantName, quantity, unitPrice, lineTotal]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        variantId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        productId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        productName:
          type: string
        variantName:
          type: string
        quantity:
          type: integer
        unitPrice:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        lineTotal:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
    CartResponse:
      type: object
      required: [items, subtotal]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CartItem'
        subtotal:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
    ReplaceCartRequest:
      type: object
      required: [items]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CartLineInput'
    MergeCartRequest:
      type: object
      required: [guestItems]
      properties:
        guestItems:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CartLineInput'
        strategy:
          type: string
          enum: [merge, guest_wins]
          default: merge
    WishlistItem:
      type: object
      required: [productId, addedAt]
      properties:
        productId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        addedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    WishlistResponse:
      type: object
      required: [items]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/WishlistItem'
    ReplaceWishlistRequest:
      type: object
      required: [productIds]
      properties:
        productIds:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
            format: uuid
    ImportWishlistRequest:
      type: object
      required: [productIds]
      properties:
        productIds:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
            format: uuid
    ShippingAddress:
      type: object
      required: [fullName, line1, city, region, postalCode, country]
      properties:
        fullName:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        phone:
          type: string
        line1:
          type: string
        line2:
          type: string
        city:
          type: string
        region:
          type: string
          description: US state code
        postalCode:
          type: string
        country:
          type: string
          enum: [US]
    CouponValidation:
      type: object
      required: [valid]
      properties:
        valid:
          type: boolean
        code:
          type: string
        rejectionReason:
          type: string
          enum: [invalid, expired, minimum_not_met, excluded_items, already_applied]
        discount:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
    CheckoutQuoteRequest:
      type: object
      required: [shippingAddress]
      properties:
        useServerCart:
          type: boolean
          default: true
        lines:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CartLineInput'
        shippingAddress:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShippingAddress'
        couponCode:
          type: string
    CheckoutQuoteResponse:
      type: object
      required: [lines, subtotal, discount, shipping, tax, total, coupon]
      properties:
        lines:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CartItem'
        subtotal:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        discount:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        shipping:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        tax:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        total:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        coupon:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/CouponValidation'
        taxDisclaimer:
          type: string
    CreateOrderRequest:
      type: object
      required: [shippingAddress, idempotencyKey]

          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShippingAddress'
        couponCode:

        useServerCart:

        lines:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/CartLineInput'
        idempotencyKey:
          type: string
          maxLength: 64
    ShopperOrderStatus:
      type: string
      enum: [awaiting_payment, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded]
    OrderSummary:
      type: object
      required: [id, orderNumber, createdAt, total, shopperStatus]

        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        orderNumber:
          type: string

        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        total:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        shopperStatus:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShopperOrderStatus'
    OrderListResponse:
      type: object
      required: [items, total, page, pageSize]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderSummary'
        total:
          type: integer
        page:
          type: integer
        pageSize:
          type: integer
    OrderLineItem:
      type: object
      required: [productName, variantName, sku, quantity, unitPrice, lineTotal]
      properties:
        productName:
          type: string
        variantName:
          type: string
        sku:
          type: string
        quantity:
          type: integer
        unitPrice:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        lineTotal:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
    OrderDetail:

          type: string
          format: uuid
        orderNumber:
          type: string

          type: string

        subtotal:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        discount:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        shipping:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        tax:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        total:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/Money'
        couponCode:
          type: string
        shippingAddress:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/ShippingAddress'
        carrierName:
          type: string
        trackingNumber:
          type: string
    SupportMessageRequest:
      type: object
      required: [email, subject, body]
      properties:
        email:
          type: string
          format: email
        subject:
          type: string
          maxLength: 120
        body:
          type: string
          maxLength: 2000
        orderNumber:
          type: string
    SupportMessageResponse:
      type: object
      required: [id, message]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        message:
          type: string

","prisma_schema":"generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum OrderStatus {
  pending_payment
  paid
  fulfilled
  delivered
  cancelled
  refunded
}

enum PaymentProvider {
  MOCK
  STRIPE
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  requires_payment_method
  processing

structured_output.overview: ShopEase Release 2 (M3 — shopper depth) extends the existing M1 Flutter catalog and M2 NestJS catalog API with authenticated commerce: JWT auth, API-backed cart and wishlist with guest-local counterparts and merge/import on login, merchandised home, enriched product discovery (search, sort, brand and availability filters), US-only checkout with flat shipping, fixed-percent tax, single coupon, mock server-side payment (no Stripe), order history with shopper-facing status labels and shipment tracking, mock password reset, and simulated support. The global API prefix is /api/v1. Contract-first OpenAPI 3.1 is the source of truth; PostgreSQL 16 via Prisma stores all server state. Exactly 24 counted API operations (excluding GET /health and OpenAPI JSON). Twelve new work items WI-010–WI-021. Money is integer USD cents everywhere on the wire and in the database.

components.name: Flutter ShopEase App (Android-first)
components.responsibility: Shopper UI: home merchandising, catalog discovery, guest and signed-in cart/wishlist, checkout, mock payment, orders, auth, support and legal placeholders. Uses generated OpenAPI client (dart-dio), Riverpod, go_router, flutter_secure_storage for tokens.
components.technology: Flutter 3.x, Dart, Riverpod, go_router, dio, freezed/json_serializable, integration_test

components.name: NestJS API Server
components.responsibility: HTTP API implementing OpenAPI contract: auth, catalog/home, cart, wishlist, checkout quotes, orders, mock payments with stock reservation, coupons, users, support stub. Thin controllers, domain services, PrismaService for persistence.

components.name: PostgreSQL Database
components.responsibility: System of record for users, catalog, carts, wishlists, coupons, orders, payments (mock), inventory reservations, password-reset tokens, support messages, home merchandising.

components.name: Docker Compose Staging
components.responsibility: Local/staging stack: API + Postgres for emulator (10.0.2.2) and CI e2e.

components.name: OpenAPI Contract & Generated Dart Client
components.responsibility: Single contract drives NestJS Swagger validation and packages/api_client code generation; prevents hand-written endpoints in mobile.

backend_modules.name: HealthModule
backend_modules.responsibility: Liveness and database connectivity probe for deploy and emulator smoke tests.

backend_modules.name: AuthModule
backend_modules.responsibility: Register, login, logout, refresh tokens, mock forgot/reset password. Passwords hashed with bcrypt or argon2; refresh tokens stored hashed.

backend_modules.name: UsersModule
backend_modules.responsibility: Account self-service: profile read optional in app; account deletion (soft-delete user, revoke tokens, anonymize where required).

backend_modules.name: CatalogModule
backend_modules.responsibility: M2 baseline product list/detail extended with brand and availability filters, sort, search; category list for navigation.

backend_modules.name: HomeModule
backend_modules.responsibility: Merchandised home payload: banners, featured and new-arrival product summaries, category entry points.

backend_modules.name: CartModule
backend_modules.responsibility: Signed-in user cart CRUD via replace semantics; merge guest cart on login (combine quantities per variant; fallback replace account cart with guest cart if merge fails). Prices snapshotted on cart lines from current variant price.

backend_modules.name: WishlistModule
backend_modules.responsibility: Signed-in wishlist; one-time import merges local guest favorites without duplicate variants.

backend_modules.name: CheckoutModule
backend_modules.responsibility: Pre-order quote: validates US address fields, applies single coupon, computes subtotal/discount/shipping/tax/total in integer cents using seeded StoreConfig (free shipping threshold 7500 cents, flat rate 599 cents, tax 8% on taxable subtotal after discount).

backend_modules.name: OrdersModule
backend_modules.responsibility: Create order in pending_payment with line snapshots and stock reservation; mock payment marks paid; cancel/abandon releases reservation. List/detail for signed-in user with shopper status labels and shipment fields.

backend_modules.name: PaymentsModule
backend_modules.responsibility: Internal mock payment record linked to order; no external processor calls in Release 2. Invoked from OrdersModule complete-mock-payment.

backend_modules.name: SupportModule
backend_modules.responsibility: Persist support form submissions and return simulated-send confirmation (no outbound email in R2).

structured_output.data_model_notes: ProductVariant tracks stockQuantity and reservedQuantity; available = stockQuantity - reservedQuantity. Checkout create order increments reservedQuantity; mock pay decrements stockQuantity and reservedQuantity; cancel/failed pay decrements reservedQuantity only. CartItem and OrderItem store productName, variantName, unitPriceCents, currency at write time. Order includes human-readable orderNumber (unique), discountCents, optional couponCode, shipping/tax/total cents, shippingAddressSnapshot JSON for immutability, carrierName and trackingNumber populated when demo fulfillment marks shipped. Coupon supports PERCENT or FIXED_AMOUNT, minSubtotalCents, expiresAt, maxRedemptions optional, exclusions via CouponExclusion (category or product). WishlistItem unique per user+variant. User soft-delete via deletedAt; login rejected when deleted. PasswordResetToken single-use mock flow; forgot-password always returns 200 for unknown emails. HomeBanner ordered by sortOrder. Product.isFeatured and Product.isNewArrival drive home sections. Availability for filters: OUT_OF_STOCK when available<=0, LOW_STOCK when 0<available<=lowStockThreshold (seed default 5), IN_STOCK otherwise — exposed on ProductSummary as availability enum. Payment.provider=MOCK for Release 2; stripe fields nullable for future. StoreConfig singleton row seeded with shipping and tax rates.
security: JWT access tokens (~15 min) and refresh tokens (~7 days); refresh stored server-side as hash; logout revokes refresh token.
Passwords hashed with bcrypt (cost 12) or argon2id; never logged or returned.
Bearer auth on all cart, wishlist, checkout, orders, users, logout, refresh except public catalog/home/auth register/login/forgot-password.
Account deletion: soft-delete user, revoke refresh tokens, clear PII fields where feasible, retain order snapshots for legal minimum.
Rate-limit auth and support endpoints in staging; validate all DTOs with class-validator; config via @nestjs/config with Joi/class validation at startup.
Mobile: tokens only in flutter_secure_storage; debug cleartext limited to 10.0.2.2; release HTTPS only.
Mock payment: no card data, no Stripe keys; complete-mock-payment idempotent per order in pending_payment only.
Errors: { statusCode, error, message } with correct HTTP status; no stack traces in production responses.

adrs.title: Mock demo payment instead of Stripe for Release 2
adrs.context: PRD requires demo-safe checkout without processor keys, webhooks, or card collection. M2 schema anticipated Stripe PaymentIntents.
adrs.decision: Release 2 uses POST /orders/{orderId}/complete-mock-payment to transition pending_payment→paid and create a Payment row with provider MOCK. Stock is reserved at order creation and committed on mock pay. Stripe integration remains a future ADR without changing order line snapshot rules.
adrs.consequences: Positive: zero external payment dependency for pilots. Negative: payment flow must be swapped for real Stripe later; Payment table keeps optional stripe fields nullable.

adrs.title: Guest cart local-only with explicit server merge on login
adrs.context: Guests shop without accounts; signed-in users need API persistence; US-003 requires merge with quantity combine and documented guest-wins fallback.
adrs.decision: Guest cart and guest wishlist live in device local storage. On successful login/register, client calls POST /cart/merge with guest lines; server merges by variantId summing quantities capped by available stock. If merge fails, client may call PUT /cart with guest lines (replace). Wishlist uses POST /wishlist/import similarly.
adrs.consequences: Positive: no guest session tracking on server; fits 24-op budget. Negative: cart not recoverable across devices until sign-in; merge edge cases must be QA-tested.

adrs.title: Checkout quote endpoint for tax, shipping, and coupon validation
adrs.context: Single coupon with complex rejection reasons; totals must be integer cents; client must show totals before order creation without duplicating business rules.
adrs.decision: POST /checkout/quote accepts cart lines (or uses server cart for signed-in users), US shipping address, optional couponCode; returns full breakdown and couponValidation result. POST /orders uses same server-side calculator to prevent tampering.
adrs.consequences: Positive: one source of truth for promo rules; clear error codes for UI. Negative: extra round trip before place order; server must keep quote logic in shared CheckoutPricingService.
